description: Use this when the person wants their palimpalem website to be visible to everyone, e.g. after maintenance mode. Requires palimpalem sign-in. Without confirm=true it only reports what would happen and changes nothing; with confirm=true (only after the person agreed) it publishes and returns the live address.

confirm.description: true only after the person has confirmed that the website should go public.

web.description: The website: its name, its palimpalem address or its own domain.

name: publicar_web
title: Publish my website
